about: WS-65 anchoring fixtures (anchor.Set.Place). Each case builds anchor.Files from files[] (head is the file at head, absent when unknown; head_unread true is a head the caller did not read), anchors snippet filed against path, and expects want, an anchor.Anchor as JSON. A snippet NewSnippet refuses is unanchored with anchor.SnippetReason. Deterministic: no model, no git, no clock.
